user.title: ASF02 Pet Feeder
user.description: Enter the feeder's MAC address (shown in the vendor app, or the last six characters are in its advertised name).

token.title: Pairing token
token.description: Enter the 10-character pairing token from the vendor app. Lost it? Check 'Generate a new token' — this re-pairs the feeder and the old token stops working.

data.generate_token: Generate a new token and re-pair the feeder (old token is discarded)

error.invalid_token: That doesn't look like a 10-character token, or the feeder rejected it.
error.invalid_mac: That doesn't look like a valid MAC address.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the feeder over Bluetooth. Check the adapter/proxy and try again.

abort.scanner_not_connectable: {name} was seen by an advertisement-only scanner that can't carry a GATT connection. Use a local Bluetooth adapter or an ESPHome bluetooth_proxy with active: true.

wait.name: Wait for completion
wait.description: Block until the dispense finishes (up to ~15 min for large counts). Off by default: returns right after the feed command is accepted; progress is visible in the feed count sensor.

init.title: ASF02 Options
init.description:
Current pairing token: **{token}** — back this up, it's the only way to re-pair if you lose access.

Lower intervals update the sensors faster but increase Bluetooth airtime and battery drain on the feeder. Use 1-minute intervals for debugging only.

data.change_token: Change the pairing token (re-pairs the feeder)

token.title: Change pairing token
token.description: Enter the current token, or generate a new one. Generating re-pairs the feeder and the old token stops working.

data.generate_token: Generate a new token and re-pair the feeder (old token is discarded)

error.invalid_token: That doesn't look like a 10-character token, or the feeder rejected it.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the feeder over Bluetooth. Check the adapter/proxy and try again.
